purpose: Measure PPO improvement from a behavior-cloned starting policy; demonstration-only performance remains a separate baseline.

evaluation.initial_means: Same full policy tensors as the learned behavior-cloning parent, with zero additional PPO updates.

selection: Fixed final supervised epoch and fixed final PPO budget; report all registered intermediate checkpoints. No performance gate controls whether the PPO pilot runs. Technical checks must pass first.
resource_policy: One simulator process during short validation, PPO and evaluation; existing two coordinators continue unchanged. Maximum four simultaneous simulator processes.
failure_behavior: Stop on failure and preserve every artifact; no automatic relaunch.
limitations: One training seed and reused development scenarios; fresh-seed replication is required before promotion.
Teacher uses privileged simulator state for labels; student inference is local.
Route guidance and static filtering remain active; aircraft-conflict filtering is disabled for the student.
Behavior cloning alone is not an RL contribution. PPO gains must be measured against its own pretrained initial policy.
PPO experience counts exclude demonstrations, which are retained separately.
The direct-action pretrained recipe differs from prior goal-offset pilots; cross-study differences do not isolate pretraining alone.
